  P .U. (A) 364
CONSTRUCTION INDUSTRY PAYMENT AND ADJUDICATION ACT 2012

CONSTRUCTION INDUSTRY PAYMENT AND ADJUDICATION (AMENDMENT)
REGULATIONS 2025

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 39 of the Construction Industry Payment
and Adjudication Act 2012 [Act 746], the Minister, upon considering the recommendation
of the Asian International Arbitration Centre, makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Construction Industry Payment
and Adjudication (Amendment) Regulations 2025.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 January 2026.

Amendment of enacting clause
2. The Construction Industry Payment and Adjudication Regulations 2014
[P .U. (A) 103/2014 ], which are referred to as the "principal Regulations"
in these Regulations, are amended in the enacting clause by substituting for the
words " the Kuala Lumpur Regional Centre of Arbitration (KLRCA) " the words
"the Asian International Arbitration Centre" .

Amendment of regulation 2
3. Regulation 2 of the principal Regulations is amended—

(a) in the shoulder note, by substituting for the word " KLRCA" the word s
"Asian International Arbitration Centre";

(b) by substituting for the word s "KLRCA is responsible " the word s
"Asian International Arbitration Centre is responsible"; and

(c) in paragraph (a), by substituting for the words "KLRCA's" the words
"Asian International Arbitration Centre's" .

  P .U. (A) 364
Substitution of regulation 3
4. The p rincipal Regulations are amended by substituting for regulation 3
the following regulation:

"Asian International Arbitration Centre's Panel of Adjudicators
3. (1) The Asian International Arbitration Centre shall maintain a register
of the Asian International Arbitration Centre's Panel of Adjudicators.

 (2) The Asian International Arbitration Centre  may remove the name
and other particulars of an adjudicator from the Asian International Arbitration
Centre's Panel of Adjudicators if—

(a) the adjudicator requests in writing for his name to be
removed from the Asian International Arbitration Centre 's
Panel of Adjudicators; or

(b) the adjudicator ceases to satisfy the competency standard
and criteria as an adjudicator as specified in regulation 4.

 (3) For the purpose of paragraph (2) (b), the Asian International
Arbitration Centre  shall notify the adjudicator before the name and other
particulars of the adjudicator is removed from the Asian International
Arbitration Centre's Panel of Adjudicators." .

Amendment of regulation 4
5. Paragraph 4(a) of the principal Regulations is amended  by substituting for
the word "KLRCA" the words "Asian International Arbitration Centre".

Amendment of regulation 5
6. Regulation 5 of the principal Regulations is amended by substituting for the words
"Director of the KLRCA" wherever appearing the word "President" .

  P .U. (A) 364
Amendment of regulation 6
7. Regulation 6 of the principal Regulations is amended—

(a) in the shoulder note, by substituting for the word s "KLRCA's" the word s
"Asian International Arbitration Centre's"; and

(b) by substituting for the words "KLRCA's" the word s "Asian International
Arbitration Centre's".

Amendment of regulation 8
8. Regulation 8 of the principal Regulations is amended—

(a) in subregulations (1) and (2) , by substituting for the words
"Director of the KLRCA" wherever appearing the words "Asian International
Arbitration Centre"; and

(b) in subregulation (3) , by substituting for the word "KLRCA" wherever
appearing the words "Asian International Arbitration Centre".

Amendment of Schedule
9. The principal Regulations are amended in the Schedule—

(a) in the heading, by substituting for the word s "KLRCA'S" the word s
"ASIAN INTERNATIONAL ARBITRATION CENTRE'S";

(b) by substituting for Part I the following part:
